programs.rules: New terms since October 1, 2026. Maximum for a house or for a duplex, triplex or multi-unit building.

programs.rules: New terms since October 1, 2026. Maximum for a house or for a duplex, triplex or multi-unit building.

programs.name: Rénoclimat: windows (duplex, triplex, multi-unit)

programs.name: LogisVert: solar panels
programs.rules: Can cover up to 40% of the purchase and installation cost. Shown but not added to your total.

amount.label: $700 to $1,000, up to $35,000 in a flood zone

programs.rules: Prevention work. A guided path starts with a mandatory climate resilience diagnostic. Shown but not added to your total.

programs.name: National Heat Pump Rebate (federal, not open yet)
programs.rules: Announced October 8, 2026 and expected to launch in early 2027. The income line, eligible homes and how it combines with provincial programs are not published, so this is shown but not added to your total.

notes: Rénoclimat's new portal was under development on October 21, 2026, so keep your invoices and the contractor's signed form.
Amounts are the most a program pays. Your rebate depends on your quote and final invoice.
